harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: (والكتاب المبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is for the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) (أقسم) "I swear".

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «قرآنا» is a second object, and the clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في أم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عَليّ»; «لدينا»: an adverb of place attached to «عليّ»; the clause «وإنه لعليّ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «أفنضرب» is resumptive; «صفحا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), a synonym of its governor in meaning standing in for it; «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن كنتم» is accusative by removal of the preposition (اللام).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «أرسلنا» is resumptive; «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) one, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; the preposition and its genitive noun «من نبي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأولين» is attached to «أرسلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وما يأتيهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the earlier clause «أرسلنا»; «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «نبي» is the fāʿil (agent); «إلا» is for restriction; the clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نبي», and what permits the indefiniteness is the preceding negation; the preposition and its genitive noun «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يستهزئون».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «فأهلكنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما يأتيهم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أشد»; «بطشا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «ولئن سألتهم» is resumptive; the clause «من خلق» is the second object of the asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq); the clause «ليقولُن» is the answer to the oath; the verb is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent); «العليم» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «الذي» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «العزيز»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the second object of the second «جعل» is attached; and the clause «لعلكم تهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: His saying «والذي»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نزل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بقدر» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «ماء»; the clause «فأنشرنا» is conjoined to «نزل»; «بلدة» is described with «ميت» because it is in the sense of «البلد»; the clause «تخرجون» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items; and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: you will be brought forth with a bringing-forth like that bringing-forth.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «والذي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding one; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الفلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to the second object of «جعل»; «ما» is a relative noun, the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The interpreted maṣdar in the genitive «لتستووا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل»; «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to «تذكروا»; the clause «وما كنا له» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وإنَّا ... لمنقلبون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the preposition and its genitive noun «إلى ربنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منقلبون».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «وجعلوا» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; «مبين» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one; the clause «اتخذ» is resumptive; «بنات» is the first object of «اتخذ»; the preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اتخذ».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «ضرب» here carries the meaning of «جعل» (to make): its first object is the implied (muqaddar) hāʾ and the second is «مثلا»; and the clause «وهو كظيم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «أوَمَنْ ينشأ» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being: do they make one who is brought up among ornaments a child [of Allah]? The preposition and its genitive noun «في الحلية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينشَّأ»; the clause «وهو غير مبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الخصام» is attached to «مبين»; it is permitted for the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to govern what precedes the muḍāf because «غير» is in the sense of «لا».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «وجعلوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the verb «يجعلون» implied (muqaddar) in the previous verse; «إناثا» is the second object of «جعلوا»; the interrogative clause is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ستكتب شهادتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وقالوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the earlier clause {وَجَعَلُوا}, and the conditional clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause «ما لهم بذلك من علم» is resumptive; «علم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition and its genitive noun «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «بذلك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «علم»; the clause «إن هم» is resumptive; «إن» is negative, and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive; «كتابا» is a second object; the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كتابا»; the clause «فهم به مستمسكون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «آتيناهم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «به» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «قالوا» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «على أمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آباءنا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «على آثارهم» is attached to «مهتدون».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «أرسلنا» is resumptive; the kāf is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: the matter is thus; the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلك» is attached to «أرسلنا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في قرية» is attached to «أرسلنا»; «نذير» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «من» is redundant (zāʾida) and «إلا» is for restriction; the clause «قال» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «وإنا مقتدون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إنا وجدنا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «على آثارهم» is attached to «مقتدون».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: (قال أولو جئتكم بأهدى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The hamza is interrogative; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the conditional clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, i.e.: will you do that even if I bring you; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is implied (muqaddar), indicated by what precedes it; and the circumstantial wāw conjoins to an implied ḥāl for comprehensiveness, i.e.: will you do that in every state, even if I bring you something better guiding? The preposition and its genitive noun «بأهدى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جئتكم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «ممَّا» is attached to «أهدى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليه» is attached to a ḥāl of «آباءكم»; «كافرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «فانتقمنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {قَالُوا}; the clause «فانظر» is conjoined to the clause «انتقمنا»; the clause «كان» is the object of the looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, [the looking] carrying the meaning of knowing; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar of kāna, and «عاقبة» is its noun.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ»: an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) "remember"; «براء» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) occurring in the place of the adjective «بريء», and it is not put in the dual or plural or feminine; the preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «براء».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «الذي» is accusative as an exception; the clause «فإنه سيهدين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فطرني»; the verb is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the first yāʾ; the nūn is of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the second yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it has been omitted for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «وجعلها» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «في عقبه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «باقية»; and the clause «لعلهم يرجعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «متعت» is resumptive; «آباءهم» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «هؤلاء»; the maṣdar «أن جاءهم» is genitive by «حتى», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متَّعت»; «ورسول» is a noun conjoined to «الحق».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {مَتَّعْتُ}; the clause «وإنا به كافرون» is conjoined to the clause «هذا سحر»; the preposition and its genitive noun «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «وقالوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause «قالوا»; «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ); the preposition and its genitive noun «من القريتين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رجل»; «عظيم» is a second naʿt of «رجل».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «معيشتهم»; the adverb «فوق» is attached to «رفعنا»; «درجات» is a second object; the interpreted maṣdar of «يتخذ» is genitive, attached to «رفعنا»; «سخريا» is a second object; the clause «ورحمت ربك خير» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to «خير».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar «أن يكون» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing"; the preposition and its genitive noun «لمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the preposition and its genitive noun «لبيوتهم» is a badal (substitute) from «لمن» and is attached to what it is attached to; the preposition and its genitive noun «من فضة» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «سقفا». The clause «يظهرون» is a naʿt of «معارج»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليها» is attached to «يظهرون».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: His saying «ولبيوتهم»: this preposition and its genitive noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to {لِمَنْ} and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what it is attached to; «أبوابا» is a noun conjoined to {سُقُفًا}; the clause «يتكئون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سررا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليها» is attached to «يتكئون».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: His saying «وزخرفا»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «سررا»; the clause «وإن كل ذلك» is resumptive; «إن» is lightened from the heavy one and inoperative; «كل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «لما», in the sense of «إلا», is a particle of restriction; «متاع» is the khabar (predicate) of «كل»; the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa) did not enter after the lightened «إن» because the context indicates affirmation. The clause «والآخرة للمتقين» is resumptive; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المتقين».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «من» is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «فهو له قرين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نقيِّض»; the preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قرين».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «وإنهم ليصدونهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ}; the clause «ويحسبون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يصدونهم», and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). He observed the wording of «مَنْ» first and so used the singular in His saying {نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ}, then observed its meaning and so used the plural in His saying «وإنهم ليصدونهم». The interpreted maṣdar from «أنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «حسب».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The clause after «حتى» is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); «بعد» is the noun of «ليت»; «يا» is for drawing attention; the clause «فبئس القرين» is resumptive, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: you.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: (ولن ينفعكم اليوم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; «اليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينفعكم»; «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to «ينفعكم». [If it is asked:] «ينفعكم» is future because it is joined with «لن», which negates the future, so how can it govern an adverb indicating present time? The answer is that the present is close to the future; and the implied form of «إذ» is: when your wrongdoing became clear and established. The interpreted maṣdar from «أنَّ» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of «ينفع»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في العذاب» is attached to «مشتركون».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «العمي»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في ضلال» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: His saying «فإما»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إن» is conditional, making [the verb] jussive; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); [«نذهبن» is] an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of the jussive; the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن», «منتقمون».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «فإنَّا عليهم مقتدرون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding apodosis by «أو»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مُقتدرون».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «فاستمسك» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إنك على صراط».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «وإنه لذكر لك» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّكَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ}; the preposition and its genitive noun «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكر»; and the clause «وسوف تسألون» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «واسأل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «استمسك»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من رسلنا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مَنْ»; the clause «أجعلنا» is the second object of the asking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; the preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to the second object; and the clause «يعبدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آلهة».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «موسى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «إلى فرعون» is attached to «أرسلنا»; and the clause «فقال» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أرسلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {فَقَالَ}; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause «هم منها يضحكون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), although the apodosis of «لما» may not be joined with the fāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يضحكون».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وما نريهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding conditional clause; «آية» is the second object of «نريهم», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction; the clause «هي أكبر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آية», and what permits the owner of the ḥāl to be indefinite is the preceding negation; the preposition and its genitive noun «من أختها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أكبر»; the clause «وأخذناهم» is conjoined to the clause «ما نريهم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالعذاب» is attached to «أخذناهم»; and the clause «لعلهم يرجعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive. «أيها»: «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and «ها» is for drawing attention; «الساحر» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادع»; and the clause «إننا لمهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause after it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ونادى» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «في قومه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نادى»; the clause «قال» explains the calling; the clause «وهذه الأنهار تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; and the clause «تبصرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, for digression (iḍrāb); the preposition and its genitive noun «من هذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير»; «الذي» is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; and the clause «ولا يكاد» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «هو مهين».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The fāʾ links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: if he is truthful, then why have [bracelets] not been cast; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); the preposition and its genitive noun «من ذهب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أسورة»; «مقترنين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «فاستخفَّ» is resumptive; the clause «فأطاعوه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «استخف»; and the clause «إنهم كانوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أطاعوه»; «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the third-person pronoun «هم».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «سلفا» is a second object; the preposition and its genitive noun «للآخرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مثلا».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «مثلا» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «ضرب» being made to carry the meaning of «جعل»; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the preposition and its genitive noun «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصدُّون».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «أم» is the connected (muttaṣila) conjunctive one; «هو» is a detached pronoun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «آلهتنا»; the clause «ما ضربوه» is resumptive; «جدلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «بل هم قوم» is resumptive; and «خصمون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «إنْ» is negative; the clause «أنعمنا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عبد»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لبني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «مثلا».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The conditional clause is parenthetical between the two conjoined items; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is in the sense of "instead of", and it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to «يخلفون»; and the clause «يخلفون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ملائكة».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «وإنه لعلم للساعة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنْ هُوَ إِلا عَبْدٌ}; the clause «فلا تمترُنَّ» is conjoined to the clause «إنه لعلم للساعة»; [«تمترن» is] an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and the implied (muqaddar) wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «واتبعون» is conjoined to the clause «لا تمترُنَّ»; and the clause «هذا صراط» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «ولا يصدنَّكم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «اتبعون»; the clause «إنه لكم عدو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشيطان»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالحكمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جئتكم»; the interpreted maṣdar in the genitive «لأبين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «بالحكمة» and is attached to what it is attached to, i.e.: I have come to you with wisdom and for making clear; the relative noun «الذي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «فاتقوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); the fāʾ is conjunctive, and the clause «فاعبدوه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause «إن الله ربي»; the clause «هذا صراط» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clause «فاختلف الأحزاب» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لما جاء عيسى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من بينهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الأحزاب»; the clause «فويل للذين» is conjoined to the clause «اختلف الأحزاب»; beginning with the indefinite «ويل» is permitted because it indicates an imprecation; the preposition and its genitive noun «للذين» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «ويل»; and «من عذاب» is attached to the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «الساعة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the maṣdar «أن تأتيهم» is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «الساعة»; «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl clause.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: «يومئذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is for compensation; the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) is the clause «بعضهم لبعض عدو»; «بعضهم» is a second mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun «لبعض» is attached to «عدو»; and «المتقين» is excepted.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «يا عباد لا خوف عليكم» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) resumptive saying; the clause «لا خوف عليكم» is the answer to the vocative, resumptive; «لا» is negative, operating like laysa; the adverb «اليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: «الذين» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they"; and the clause «وكانوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «آمنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «ادخلوا» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative; «أنتم» is a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «وأزواجكم» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أنتم»; and the clause «تحبرون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «أنتم».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «يطاف» is resumptive; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition and its genitive noun «من ذهب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «صحاف»; the clause «وفيها ما تشتهيه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يطاف»; and the clause «وأنتم فيها خالدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «عليهم», by way of a shift of person (iltifāt).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: His saying «وتلك الجنة»: a mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being the clause {لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ} in the next verse; «الجنة» is a badal (substitute); «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الجنة»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أورثتموها».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; the clause «تأكلون» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «فاكهة»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منها» is attached to «تأكلون».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في عذاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «خالدون».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «لا يفتَّر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {خَالِدُونَ}; the clause «وهم فيه مبلسون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لا يفتَّر»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مبلسون».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «وما ظلمناهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {لا يُفَتَّرُ}; the clause «ولكن كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما ظلمناهم»; «هم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw in «كانوا».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «ونادوا» is resumptive; the lām in «ليقض» is the lām of command that makes [the verb] jussive; and the clause «قال» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «لقد جئناكم» is the answer to the oath; the clause «ولكن أكثركم كارهون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جئناكم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «للحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كارهون».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause «فإنَّا مبرمون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أبرموا».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «حسب»; «بلى» is a particle of answer; the clause «ورسلنا يكتبون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; «لديهم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يكتبون»; and the implied (muqaddar) answer clause is resumptive, i.e.: yes, We hear.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «إن» is conditional, i.e.: if that were true, then I would be the first to worship him; but it is not true.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «سبحان» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is implied (muqaddar); the second «رب» is a badal (substitute); the preposition and its genitive noun «عَمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «أسبِّح» (I glorify); and «ما» is maṣdariyya.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «فذرهم» is resumptive; the clause «يخوضوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; the genitive maṣdar «حتى يُلاقوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخوضوا»; «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive, made up of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «في السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «إله», because it is in the sense of "worshipped"; «إله» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He", and the clause «هو إله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and this omitted [pronoun] is the returning pronoun, the implied form being: and He is the one who in heaven is God; it was omitted because of the length of the ṣila. His saying «وفي الأرض إله» is like its preceding counterpart; and the clause «وهو الحكيم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «وهو الذي».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «وتبارك» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ}; «الذي» is the fāʿil (agent) of «تبارك»; the clause «له ملك» is the ṣila (relative clause); «ما» is conjoined to «الأرض»; the clause «عنده علم» is conjoined to the relative clause; and the clause «ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «عنده علم الساعة».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «ولا يملك» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted returning pronoun, i.e.: those whom they call upon, being other than Him, do not possess; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, excepted; and the clause «وهم يعلمون» is a ḥāl clause.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «ولئن سألتهم» is resumptive; the clause «مَنْ خلقهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq); the clause «ليقولُن» is the answer to the oath; «الله» is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e.: Allah created us; the clause «فأنى يؤفكون» is resumptive; «أنى» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the sense of "how".

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, and «قيله» is a genitive noun, that by which the oath is sworn, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) «أقسم» (I swear); «القول», «القيل» and «القال» have one meaning. The clause «إن هؤلاء قوم» is the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position, resumptive; the clause «يا رب إن هؤلاء قوم» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the answer to the oath is omitted, i.e.: I shall surely do with them what I wish; and the clause «لا يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «فاصفح» is resumptive; «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being what the implied (muqaddar) preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» is attached to; and the clause «فسوف يعلمون» is resumptive.
